page.layout: One printed page. Below a woodcut ornamental border at the top: a centred dedication title in large capitals and spaced type, then a centred italic-free closing line in small roman type, then a signature line in small capitals at the right. No margin notes.

main_text.head: VIRO CONSULTISSIMO, PRUDENTISSIMO AC LITERATISSIMO, DN. DANIELI IMHOOF, PRÆFECTURIS GRANDISONENSI ET LAUSANNENSI SUMMA CUM LAUDE DEFUNCTO, E SACRO BAPTISMATIS FONTE SUSCEPTORI SUO BENIGNISSIMO, TANQUAM PATRI OMNI HONORIS GENERE SUSPICIUNDO.
main_text.p: Disputationem hancce humillimè dicat, dedicat, offert

page.notes: The woodcut border at the top is an ornament and is not transcribed. The text is set in several sizes of capitals, so the heading is given as one block. The closing line "Disputationem hancce humillimè dicat, dedicat, offert" is printed in small type and the signature line is set in small capitals with a larger initial letter for each name.
